SELECT X.STATUS_TEXT , X.PROCESS_TEXT , X.BS_NO /* 선입고 요청번호 */ , X.INV_NO /* 송장번호 */ , X.BEFORE_GR_DATE /* 요청일자 */ , X.WMS_IVK_DATE AS IVK_DATE /* 출고일자 */ , X.BUYER_NAME , X.AGENT_NAME || '(' || X.AGENT_TEL_NO || ')' AS AGENT_INFO , X.AGENT_NAME , X.AGENT_TEL_NO , X.MAKER_NAME , X.BUYER_ITEM_NO , X.DESCRIPTION , X.SPECIFICATION , X.ITEM_QTY , X.WMS_IVK_QTY AS IVK_QTY /* 출고지시수량 */ , X.INV_QTY AS DELIVERY_QTY /* 출고수량 */ , X.UNIT_MEASURE , X.UNIT_PRICE , X.INV_QTY * X.UNIT_PRICE AS UNIT_AMT , X.DELY_TO_LOCATION , X.REQ_USER_NAME || '(' || X.REQ_USER_TEL_NO || ')' AS REQ_USER_INFO , X.REQ_USER_NAME , X.REQ_USER_TEL_NO , X.DELIVERY_COMPANY , X.DELIVERY_NO , X.INV_NO AS IK_NO /* 송장번호 */ , X.BUYER_CODE /* 히든필드 */ , X.BUYER /* 히든필드 */ , X.AGENT_CODE /* 히든필드 */ , X.WAREHOUSE_CODE /* 히든필드 */ , X.INV_SEQ /* 히든필드 */ , X.CONTRACT_NO /* 히든필드 */ , X.CONTRACT_SEQ /* 히든필드 */ FROM ( SELECT (SELECT COM_NAME_LOC FROM ICOMCMPY WHERE COM_CODE=A.BUYER) AS BUYER_NAME , A.BEFORE_GR_DATE AS BEFORE_GR_DATE , A.PO_NO AS PO_NO , A.BUYER_ITEM_NO AS BUYER_ITEM_NO , A.DESCRIPTION AS DESCRIPTION , A.MAKER_NAME AS MAKER_NAME , A.UNIT_PRICE AS UNIT_PRICE , A.ITEM_QTY , A.REQ_USER_NAME , A.REQ_USER_DEPT_NAME , A.REQ_USER_TEL_NO , A.AGENT_NAME , A.AGENT_USER_NAME , A.AGENT_TEL_NO , A.KEP_USER_NAME , A.SPECIFICATION , A.ORIGIN_NAME , A.AGENT_PRICE , A.UNIT_MEASURE , A.BS_NO , A.BUYER AS BUYER_CODE , A.BUYER , A.CLOSE_ITEM_QTY , A.DELIVERY_FLAG , A.PROCESS_TYPE , A.DELY_TO_LOCATION , A.REQ_USER_ID , A.REQ_USER_DEPT_CODE , A.MAKER_CODE , A.ORIGIN_CODE , A.AGENT_CODE , A.AGENT_USER_ID , A.KEP_USER_ID , CASE WHEN A.STATUS = 'D' THEN 'BS99' /* 선입고취소 */ WHEN A.DELIVERY_FLAG = 'Y' THEN 'BS40' /* 납품확정 */ WHEN A.DELIVERY_FLAG = 'P' THEN 'BS30' /* 납품예정 */ WHEN B.INV_NO IS NOT NULL THEN 'BS20' /* 입고예정 */ WHEN B.INV_NO IS NULL THEN 'BS10' /* 요청 */ ELSE NULL END AS STATUS , DECODE(B.INV_QTY,0,'입고예정',B.DELIVERY_QTY,'배송','배송예정') AS STATUS_TEXT , DECODE(A.PROCESS_TYPE,'2','TR','1','재고','3','VMI') AS PROCESS_TEXT , B.INV_QTY , C.WMS_GR_QTY , C.WMS_GR_DATE , C.WMS_IVK_QTY , C.WMS_IVK_DATE , C.ADD_DATE , A.WAREHOUSE_CODE , B.INV_NO , B.INV_SEQ , A.CONTRACT_NO , A.CONTRACT_SEQ , B.DELIVERY_COMPANY , B.DELIVERY_NO FROM KEP_BEFORE_STOCKED_MNG A /* 선입고관리 */ , KEP_BEFORE_STOCKED_WMSIVDT B /* 선입고 물류센터 송장테이블 */ , KEP_BEFORE_STOCKED_IVDT C /* 선입고송장상세 */ WHERE 1=1 AND A.BUYER = B.BUYER AND A.BS_NO = B.BS_NO AND A.BUYER = C.BUYER AND A.BS_NO = C.BS_NO
AND A.BEFORE_GR_DATE >= #{st_from_date} /* 요청일FROM */ AND A.BEFORE_GR_DATE <= #{st_to_date} /* 요청일TO */
AND C.WMS_IVK_DATE >= #{st_from_date} /* 출고일FROM */ AND C.WMS_IVK_DATE <= #{st_to_date} /* 출고일TO */
AND A.BUYER IN
#{item}
AND A.WAREHOUSE_CODE = #{st_warehouse_code}
AND A.BS_NO LIKE '%' || #{st_bs_no} || '%'
AND A.BUYER_ITEM_NO LIKE '%' || #{st_buyer_item_no} || '%'
AND A.DESCRIPTION LIKE '%' || #{st_buyer_item_name} || '%'
AND A.PROCESS_TYPE IN('1', '2', '3') /* 전체 */
AND A.PROCESS_TYPE = '2' /* TR일 경우 */
AND A.PROCESS_TYPE IN ('1', '3') /* 재고/VMI일 경우 */
AND B.INV_NO LIKE '%' || #{st_inv_no} || '%'
AND B.INV_QTY <> 0 AND B.DELIVERY_QTY = 0 ORDER BY A.BUYER , A.BS_NO DESC ) X
mapper.update: UPDATE KEP_BEFORE_STOCKED_WMSIVDT WIDT /* 선입고 물류센터 송장테이블 */ SET WIDT.STATUS = 'R' , WIDT.DELIVERY_DATE = #{st_ivk_date} /* DELIVERY_DATE */ , WIDT.DELIVERY_USER_ID = #{st_user_id} /* DELIVERY_USER_ID */ , WIDT.DELIVERY_QTY = NVL(WIDT.INV_QTY,0) , WIDT.DELIVERY_COMPANY = #{st_delivery_company} /* DELIVERY_COMPANY */ , WIDT.DELIVERY_NO = #{st_delivery_no} /* DELIVERY_NO */ , WIDT.CHANGE_DATE = TO_CHAR(SYSDATE,'YYYYMMDD') , WIDT.CHANGE_TIME = TO_CHAR(SYSDATE,'HH24MMSS') WHERE 1=1 AND WIDT.WAREHOUSE_CODE = #{WAREHOUSE_CODE} AND WIDT.BUYER = #{BUYER_CODE} AND WIDT.INV_NO = #{INV_NO} AND WIDT.INV_SEQ = #{INV_SEQ} AND WIDT.STATUS <> 'D'
